newsitem.title: SWEDEN: SWEDEN'S RIKSBANK SETS REPO AT UNCHANGED 4.10 PCT.
newsitem.headline: SWEDEN'S RIKSBANK SETS REPO AT UNCHANGED 4.10 PCT.

text.p: Sweden's central bank, the Riksbank, set a one-week repurchase agreement operation at a steady, fixed 4.10 percent on Tuesday.
The operation will run from August 13 to August 20 with bids due by 0800 GMT on August 12.
The repo rate is the bank's key tool for controlling market money liquidity. It has been unchanged since December 17 when it was lowered 25 basis points.
The central bank's other key interest rates, the deposit and lending rates, stand at 3.75 percent and 5.25 percent, respectively.
